claims.statement: Bulk MoS2 is a layered material. In the 2H polytype, MoS2 has a hexagonal P63/mmc (No. 194) structure with lattice parameters near a ~ 3.15-3.16 A and c ~ 12.3 A in the admitted bulk crystallographic determinations.
claims.scope: The scientifically established chemical identity and BULK structural facts BISULFID can currently support for molybdenum disulfide: the formula MoS2; that bulk MoS2 is layered; the 2H polytype hexagon
